ceiling_directive: Close the 297/50000000 certificate gap at an explicit optimizing channel, then continue the attaining primal-dual certificate over a nonempty two-dimensional parameter cell through a sign-certified boundary of the balanced-binary equality set.
improvement_directive: Extract a simultaneous global lower certificate attaining the feasible value at a specified channel, and algebraically continue its active sets until an adjacent-cell sign change identifies an actual boundary of the balanced-binary equality set. This would replace the conditional certificate template and isolated exclusion interval with a proved design regime and transition.
critique: The note proves a general finite reduction and optimization formulation, but its substantive solved design result is confined to N=4, alpha=2/5, and an extreme privacy-budget neighborhood around lambda=1000. The unrestricted optimum at lambda=1000 is only bracketed within 5.94e-6, so no minimizing channel is identified, while the certificate-characterization theorem is conditional on precisely the optimizer-attaining global certificate that is not supplied. Consequently, the advertised phase-structure program delivers only a nonbinary exclusion interval and balanced-allocation ray, not a nonempty optimality cell, equality-set boundary, or channel transition. The hidden-assignment protocol, unconventional 60% coverage level, and absence of evidence at practically relevant privacy levels further limit the leading-econometrics significance, although the framing accurately discloses these limitations.
